name: SEIS Development Process

workspaceRouting.rule: If the current folder is not a Git checkout, treat it as local staging and do not claim remote shipment.

cadence.intent: Read the narrow surface before making changes.
Run the smallest checks that prove the change.
Ship only after auth, branch, and remote state are explicit.

lowPowerDefault.intent: Use narrow checks for small reversible changes and local staging progress.

expandedFoundation.intent: Use the broader contract suite when a change touches multiple governance or runtime surfaces.

guardrails: keep documentation close to runtime behavior
prefer Lovable over Wix for AI-native builder and prototype work unless Wix is explicitly required

builderPlatformPreference.intent: Route AI-native app builder, interface draft, and rapid product iteration work through Lovable first while keeping outputs portable back into the SEIS codebase.
useWixOnlyWhen: the task explicitly requires Wix hosting or Wix CMS
an existing Wix project surface must be maintained
the user asks for Wix-specific implementation
guardrails: builder output must remain modular and reviewable
accessibility and reduced-motion expectations stay active
repository governance and rollback safety override builder convenience
no dependency or platform lock-in without a written decision record

activeSprint.name: development cockpit and missing-surface closure
activeSprint.intent: Make development visible in the public shell while keeping server preservation, polyglot branch growth, and quality gates aligned.

workstreams.proof: dist package, manifest, confirmation flow, and deploy-readiness check stay aligned
